children.game_version: A 'follow the cow' game where children mimic the gait and horn shapes.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the arm gestures while seated, focusing on the horn shape.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the side-to-side sway with support if needed.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Women spread hands across and above their heads to represent long-horned cattle.
movement_profile.footwork: Men step from one leg to another to imitate cow movement.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Women sway from side to side.

signature_moves.description: Men step from one leg to another to imitate the walking of cows.
signature_moves.name: Cow Gait

signature_moves.description: Women spread their hands across and above their heads to represent long-horned cattle.
signature_moves.name: Horn Representation

music_profile.sound_description: The music features a combination of melodic flute lines, percussive drum beats from the Engalabi, the sound of shakers, and rhythmic hand clapping.

basic_steps: Men: Step from one leg to another to imitate cow walking.
Women: Sway from side to side.
Women: Spread hands across and above the head to represent horns.
